learning_outcomes.text: Identify a suitable method and implement a parametric or topological optimization method in Abaqus.
Know the different families of structural optimization in mechanics.
Know how to implement parametric and topological optimization techniques in Abaqus.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts: objective function to be minimized, design parameters considered, technical constraints to be met, minimization algorithms that can be used, etc.
Details of parametric and shape optimization methods:
Practical use of FE software incorporating these methods
Details of topological optimization methods (SIMP method)
Practical use of E.F. calculation software (Abaqus)
Free choice for students on the subject of application of topological optimization
bibliography: Optimisation des structures mécaniques : méthodes numériques et éléments finis, JC Craveur et col., Dunod
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
